name: Stormpike's Request
summary: Mountaineer Stormpike sends a written commission from Loch Modan to Stormwind City. He asks Furen Longbeard to craft him a shield of exceptional dwarven quality.

sections.title: A Northern Commission
sections.body: Mountaineer Stormpike needs a sturdy shield while stationed in Loch Modan. He trusts no ordinary smith with the work and asks Furen Longbeard, whose craft he greatly admires. Furen now lives among the humans in Stormwind's Dwarven District, having left Ironforge. Stormpike assumes a king's ransom drew him south, so traveling adventurers carry the commission across the kingdoms.

sections.title: The Stormpike Line
sections.body: Furen Longbeard receives Stormpike's letter in Stormwind's Dwarven District and agrees to make the shield. The Stormpike clan is proud and established, known across Khaz Modan for its martial grit and wealth. Furen welcomes word and business from his northern homeland. He sets to work on the mountaineer's order.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Stormpike's letter from Loch Modan asks Furen Longbeard to forge him a high-quality shield.
Mountaineer Stormpike wrote the letter. He is a dwarven sentry guarding the passes of Loch Modan and deeply admires Furen Longbeard's smithing.

faq.q: Where does this letter need to go?
aliases: where do i take stormpikes request
faq.answer: The letter is addressed to Furen Longbeard at his forge in Stormwind City's Dwarven District.

faq.q: Why does Stormpike hire a smith all the way in Stormwind?
faq.answer: Stormpike considers Furen's skill unmatched and will accept no other armorer. Furen left Ironforge to work among the humans in the south.

angles.text: Stormpike's request shows the standing of master armorers: patrons across kingdoms seek skilled dwarven smiths.
As a dwarf, you carry a bond of clan and craft between the mountaineers guarding Khaz Modan and craftsmen living abroad in human cities.
